offering_description.value: Sells Niagen nicotinamide riboside (NR), an NAD+ boosting ingredient, as a branded consumer supplement and as an ingredient for other supplement brands. Also supplies IV NAD+ products and runs clinical research on NAD+ for healthy aging.

primary_products.value: nicotinamide riboside ingredient; NAD+ boosting dietary supplements; intravenous NAD+ products

customer_segment.value: B2B: supplement brands and manufacturers buying NR ingredient, clinics and practitioners; B2C: consumers buying NR supplements for healthy aging

end_markets.value: dietary supplements; healthy aging; nutrition and wellness; clinical research

revenue_model.value: product sales: NR ingredient sold to supplement brands, branded supplements sold to consumers; licensing or royalties: licensing of patents and trademarks to ingredient customers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns Niagen brand and patents, contract manufacturers make products sold to consumers and brands; raw materials: supplies NR ingredient to supplement and food makers

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus international ingredient customers and online consumers

specialization.value: niche specialist: nicotinamide riboside and NAD+ related ingredient, supplement and IV products

distribution_channels.value: online: direct-to-consumer website and online marketplaces; direct sales: ingredient sales to supplement brands and manufacturers; third-party retail: retail stores selling Niagen supplements; other: clinics and practitioners for IV products
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; third-party retail; other

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: dietary supplement and ingredient rules under FDA (DSHEA, new dietary ingredient, labeling) and FTC advertising rules

notes: Formerly ChromaDex; details on current channels partly uncertain.
